content: Load-bearing cloud/enterprise nouns confirmed by vendor docs: landing zone (foundational secure multi-account environment, AWS/Azure/GCP docs), zero trust (verify explicitly, least privilege, assume breach/minimize blast radius - Microsoft CAF), blast radius (scope of incident impact, drives segmentation decisions), VPC Service Controls (GCP perimeter construct preventing data exfiltration), data residency (region-locked resource creation for GDPR/SOC2), FinOps (cost allocation/tagging/budget discipline). These delete-test as 'fails' (deleting them loses technical meaning). Pure-air buzzwords per generic business-writing sources: synergy, best-of-breed, seamless, robust, next-generation, holistic, turnkey, value-add, leverage (as verb) - these delete-test as 'passes' (sentence survives deletion).
